name: What are the essential components of an outdoor kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What are the essential components of an outdoor kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: An outdoor kitchen typically includes key elements like a grill or cooking appliance, countertop space for prep, and storage cabinets. Depending on your needs and budget, you might also consider a refrigerator, sink, bar area, or pizza oven. The essential components are chosen based on how you plan to use the space and the types of meals you'll be preparing outdoors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Essential components include a grill, countertop space, and storage. Additional features like a refrigerator or sink can be added.
